caption:
Desk all week, runs on the weekend, and glutes that always feel tight?

Tight hips and glutes are often under-used, or stuck working in one position all day. The feeling is real.

Remedial massage can ease the tension and help you move more comfortably for a while. Movement helps it last: try glute bridges, a figure-four stretch and side-lying leg lifts once or twice a day, and stand up to walk every half hour.

Groin pain, catching or locking, pain that wakes you at night or tingling down the leg is worth assessing with a physio or GP. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio work on the tension and send you home with simple moves. Book online via the link in bio.

General information only — not a substitute for an individual assessment.
